title: Choose provider row task validation authority
head: 15ea1458af6c817bd3c5566132502705a7712ad2

decision.reason: The registry accepts unknown input, parses it through providerDefSchema, and passes only parsed ProviderDef rows through the typed ProviderStore into persistence. Reads re-parse stored rows through the same schema. A DB-exported TASKS alias has no consumer and no enforcement role.

baseline.textualCorroboration: Repository-wide rg found PROVIDER_ROW_TASKS only at its declaration. Related prose claims existed in the DB schema header/block, server persistence header, and inference design; only the DB prose could imply a second local enforcement seam.

authorityTrace.parsedWrites: The registry calls store.put(row, origin) in exactly two origin arms after parse success.
authorityTrace.typedPorts: ProviderStore.put accepts ProviderDef; createConnectionPorts forwards that ProviderDef to putProviderRow.
authorityTrace.persistence: putProviderRow accepts ProviderDef; listProviderRows parses every stored row through providerDefSchema before returning it.
authorityTrace.existingNegativeProof: tests/contracts/inference/provider-schema.contract.test.ts rejects a serves task outside the selected wire ceiling and other malformed provider rows.

changes: Removed exported PROVIDER_ROW_TASKS and its TASKS value import.
Reworded DB schema comments to name providerDefSchema as the sole validation authority and the registry/read parse points.
Kept Task type usage for the Drizzle serves column; no DDL or migration change.

postDeletion.textualCorroboration: Repository-wide rg found zero PROVIDER_ROW_TASKS spellings.

constraints: No migration generated because the removed tuple was TypeScript-only and emitted no DDL.
No commit, push, merge, or live database mutation performed.
No sibling-owned inference identity, Code Mod Kit, or git-fixture file edited.
